abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait

abilities.name: Pick up

abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: probe
abilities.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

abilities.name: consult
abilities.function: Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

abilities.name: exchange
abilities.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.name: Confirmed understanding
satisfaction.rationale: A real experiment confirmed new information; repeated facts do not qualify.

satisfaction.name: Participating in an evidence exchange
satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

satisfaction.name: Being answered or remembered
satisfaction.rationale: Another person actually addressed you in response to your own recent contact, or after a long gap; one award per cooldown, decaying.

satisfaction.name: Two-way contact
satisfaction.rationale: You and another person each actually addressed the other repeatedly within a bounded window; one award per pair per window, decaying.

satisfaction.name: Own work noticed
satisfaction.rationale: Another person actually acted at or used something you made; signs are excluded, and each person counts once per object window, decaying.

notes: Berries are initially known to provide 8 nutrition with zero toxicity; hazelnut safety is not yet known.

projects.benefit: A food reserve would support safer exploration and greater freedom.

reviews.reason: Develop a general plant-cultivation operation with establishment-trial and maintenance modes. The related-capability search found no cultivation equivalent. Existing probe supports inspection and small tests, and gather transfers accessible stock, but neither establishes or maintains a planted propagule. Reuse those implementations where applicable rather than claiming their functions as new. Propagability and growing requirements remain unverified. The current observed record for start-0-roots reports stock 0 and capacity 6, not six available roots; planting must use an actually available owned input, potentially one of the five recorded roots in item-4-wren-43, subject to its current condition. A renewable harvest cannot yet be promised. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Three individual study rounds are required after implementation; study, requests, registration, scheduling and interface use alone earn no benefit. Actual observation that verifies establishment, failure, decay or a growing requirement may qualify as information gain, deduplicated by specimen, tested condition and finding rather than action name. Use the existing experience implementation and limits without changing protected accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Proposed eligibility is at most one modest information-gain event per genuinely new verified finding, with a 10-round cooldown; repeated unchanged checks award none. Familiar successful tending or a real harvest may support modest maintained satisfaction only when personally applicable, with benefit bounded by the existing event cap and subject to existing decay; do not require novelty for legitimate practice. No reward for hoped-for harvests, and no comfort or nutrition from planting. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Missing experience handlers produce evidence events for development, not direct reward-account writes.
reviews.visualReview: Use reusable plot/plant visual metadata: plot footprint, species or unknown identity, planted-material reference, observed stage, visible condition, moisture evidence, progress stage and timestamps. Emit observable events for actual soil preparation, placement, covering, visible emergence, measured growth, wilting, death and harvested stock transfer. Retain provenance and event references so visuals and experience can consume the same verified events without duplicating rewards. Initially show disturbed soil or a planted trial marker, not a mature plant. Hidden viability and unobserved roots are not disclosed by color, labels or metadata exposed to the actor. 'Established', 'growing' and 'harvestable' require their implemented evidence thresholds. Failed or interrupted planting shows its real unfinished or failed state, never a success animation. A user-visible observation deadline is not a growth progress bar.
reviews.specification:
Develop 'Cultivate plants', parameterized by mode, actual plant or propagule reference, accessible plot coordinates, quantity, and any actually supplied amendments or water. Initial executable scope: a hand-planted establishment trial in workable soil, with observation and maintenance; extend the same operation only where supported plant biology permits. No tools, water container, seed, fertilizer, or living bud is granted. References: start-0-roots at (10.1,12), observed revision foundation-forest@1; owned candidate item-4-wren-43, resource root, quantity 5, recorded decay 6.69198518; personal root record establishes nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 only. Revalidate identity, ownership, remaining quantity, decay and reach at execution. The nearby commons-root records are possible visible sources, not owned supplies. Acquiring their produce requires actual travel and gather actions.
Prerequisites: independently learned operation, living actor, sufficient energy, one owned whole root or other biologically suitable propagule, and a reachable unoccupied plot whose soil can actually be opened by hand. No eligibility inference from edibility. Inspection may establish that a candidate lacks living regenerative tissue; record that informative failure without asserting that all roots are nonpropagating. Reuse probe (open-baseline:probe:1) for actual inspection or applicable sample tests at its existing costs; consuming a 0.1-unit sample must reduce inventory and cannot silently count as a whole planted root. Reuse gather (base:gather:1, forest.gather) for later collection of exposed ripe output, with its existing one-round duration, 2 energy per unit, stock deduction and range checks. Record these dependencies in implementation metadata.
Trial costs and work: reserve one currently available whole candidate per selected plot; one plot per execution. Spend three active rounds and 3 energy total, in checkpointed stages: loosen soil, place input, cover soil. Spend 1 energy per completed stage; movement and inspection are additional existing-action costs. Soft workable soil needs no invented tool. Hard or obstructed ground blocks this version without consumption. Reserve a footprint sufficient for the input and known plant size; do not overlap occupied plants or duplicate plots. At placement atomically subtract the input from its inventory stack and create the tracked planted specimen, retaining its actual mass, condition and provenance. Covering completes planting, not establishment. No food stock is created by these stages.
Development handoff must inspect and use the experiment's actual plant and environmental mechanisms. Implement missing propagule viability, rooting, soil moisture and growth state as needed in the existing current-conversation handoff, rather than reject the request because these primitives are absent. A harvested edible root is not automatically viable. If this material cannot establish, the executable trial produces a physically grounded failure; obtaining a viable seed, crown or other propagule is then a prerequisite for another attempt, not a granted inventory item. Do not invent a successful biology or an era-based unlock.
Ongoing process: planted material experiences elapsed simulation time, actual temperature, light, soil moisture, decay and applicable hazards. Store age, condition, rooting state, accumulated growth and maintenance history. A first observation interval of 10 elapsed rounds and an initial 120-round observation window are trial scheduling parameters, not promised rooting or maturity times; surviving unresolved trials may continue. During development, define executable species-appropriate establishment thresholds, growth duration, environmental tolerances, moisture use and harvest yield from the actual world model before enabling claims of growth or harvest. If that evidence is unavailable, release only the monitored establishment precursor with unresolved outcomes explicitly labelled; do not substitute a timer that manufactures roots. All numeric biological parameters must be recorded in the implemented contract, not improvised by repeated model review. Development and review waiting advance no world time.
Maintenance: observation uses probe's actual observation cost of one round and 0.2 energy. Each physical soil-tending execution costs one round and 1 energy, only when a real obstruction or surface condition can be changed by hand. Watering is enabled only with a measured reachable water supply and an actual transfer method; debit the exact transferred quantity from that source or carried inventory and add it to plot moisture, with recorded losses. No periodic water, fertilizer, rain or labor is assumed. Maintenance needs and intervals follow measured conditions and the implemented thresholds, not automatic success after scheduled visits. Leaving a trial alone allows ordinary growth, drying, waterlogging or decay; no offscreen actor performs maintenance.
Conservation and products: preserve propagule biomass accounting; any new biomass requires modelled photosynthetic energy, water and soil nutrient uptake with explicit source debits or environmental flux accounting. Root stock becomes harvestable only after actual supported development and allocation of biomass, and gather transfers that stock rather than duplicating it. Planting consumes a potential meal; planting itself supplies no nutrition. Mature edible output, if actually produced and verified as the known root resource, retains its ordinary nutrition and toxicity semantics; neither mood nor learning changes nutrition. Failed specimens become only their measured recoverable material or decay products, not fresh food or replacement seed. Harvest that removes the regenerative plant part may end that specimen; renewability requires demonstrated survival/regrowth or another viable propagule and continued real inputs.
Lifecycle: checkpoint completed stages and charged costs. Interruption pauses active labor; exposed material and living plots continue their ordinary environmental processes during subsequent world ticks. Resume revalidates the same references and remaining requirements, never restarts free progress. Cancel before placement releases surviving reserved inventory once; cancel after placement leaves the real specimen in the plot. Recovery requires an actual reachable removal action and may damage the specimen. Spent time, energy, degraded material and consumed water are never refunded. Actor death stops labor, releases surviving unplaced escrow through ordinary death/inventory rules, and leaves planted specimens subject to normal ecology; no automatic harvesting or ownership transfer. Global simulation pauses freeze all processes. No permissions or consent are inferred for any actor or plot.

reviews.reason: The existing probe operation directly covers feasible non-ingestive examination and small physical trials of an owned sample. Its observe, press, wet and heat arguments already provide general assessment modes; a new food-assessment capability would duplicate that function. The related-capability search and retrieved probe contract support reuse. The requested outcome explicitly permits unresolved uncertainty, so an observation yielding no evidence about safety or nutrition is a valid limited result, not grounds to invent an assay. Collection has already succeeded: the supplied ownership record contains two hazelnut units.
reviews.experienceReview: Reuse grants no learning, mastery, pleasure, satisfaction or nutrition. A completed observation or physical trial may qualify as verified information gain only when its actual event establishes new evidence or an informative limitation applicable to lin. A query, request, repeated unchanged observation or unsupported safety conclusion does not qualify. Any benefit must use established executable reward rules with functional deduplication, a bounded amount and cap, decay and cooldown; absent such an applicable rule, award none rather than invent a reward. Legitimate repeated practice may support only an already-defined modest maintenance benefit. No reward account, budget, goal or permission changes; no mood-based reduction of basic nutrition and no physical-comfort benefit from this assessment.
reviews.visualReview: Reuse the existing probe interaction visuals and observable events. Reference the actual sample ID, selected mode, location, duration, completion or cancellation status, consumed quantity and any observed physical change in reusable event/visual metadata. Show examination or an attempted physical trial only when it actually occurs. Findings may be labelled observed, inconclusive or unresolved; do not show safe-food, cooked, detoxified, nutritious or successful-shell-opening imagery unless that specific real effect is established. An interrupted or failed attempt may display its actual attempt or failure, never a success marker. No new catalogue interface or visual event is presumed to exist merely because this review approved reuse.
reviews.specification: Reuse probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1; do not register a replacement or claim reinvention. Use its existing schema: target string (maximum 360 characters), mode observe|press|wet|heat, intensity number from 0 to 1, with no additional parameters. First executable action: target=item-19-lin-197, mode=observe, intensity=0, provided the actual owned stack is visible and within the handler's physical interaction range. Recheck ownership, accessibility, remaining quantity and condition at execution; ownership alone does not establish reach. The stack was harvested at tick 19 from start-1-nuts and contains two units; the old tick-15 observation is not a current stock measurement. Observation requires no additional supplied tool or consumable, takes one round and costs 0.2 energy. Report only externally observable features actually supported by the simulation, explicitly recording unavailable or inconclusive observations. No tasting or ingestion is part of this procedure. A later physical trial is a separate probe invocation costing one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit from the actual selected sample. Choose a mode only when its real physical prerequisites and supported effect are present: no water, heat source, tool, analytical instrument or external reference is granted. In particular, wet and heat cannot create their required material or energy source. Press may be attempted only to the extent actual manual force and the existing handler support it; a resistant shell is an informative limitation, not automatic access to a kernel. Record any consumed sample allocation and any real transformed material or residue without duplication; retained stock continues ageing, and no edible product or treatment is credited unless actually produced. Use only the existing handler's measurable effects; this reuse adds no cracking, cooking, toxicity assay or nutrient assay mechanism. Compare observations with lin's retained knowledge, distinguishing the personal berry record from evidence about this sample. Appearance, resemblance, pressing response or absence of visible spoilage cannot establish edibility, absence of toxins, nutritional value or a required processing recipe. Keep all unsupported properties unknown. Each action is the existing one-round interaction, with interruption=cancel and no resumable partial mastery or trial progress; another attempt is a new paid interaction. Apply the existing handler's transaction rules to interruption, cancellation or death: never award completion for an unfinished interaction, never duplicate inputs, and never refund costs already spent. Unspent or unconsumed owned material remains subject to ordinary inventory and death rules. There is no continuing assessment process, maintenance obligation or automatic future testing. Development/review waiting advances no time. Findings require actual observations, not this review.

args.function: Investigate a feasible way to prepare owned edible roots as a meal that could be shared with consenting nearby neighbors.
args.conditions: I own seven roots and 0.9 branch. Roots have previously provided nutrition when eaten. I am outdoors on ordinary soil near neighbors. No cooking vessel, fire, tool or accessible water has been established.
args.inputs: Owned edible roots; other equipment or ingredients only if actually obtained. The branch is not assumed sufficient or suitable fuel.
args.costs: Method, prerequisites, preparation time and energy costs are unknown; specify a feasible contract if one exists.
args.effects: Actual preparation consuming specified ingredients and resources, with inspectable food results and real safety constraints. No guaranteed happiness, improved nutrition, successful cooking, or automatic feeding of others.

reviews.reason: Develop a minimal unheated preparation operation, not cooking. Related-capability searches returned gathering, eating and planting, while the full probe contract supports only observation or a small material trial. None performs meal-scale preparation. Prior root consumption supports considering an unheated meal, but does not establish the present roots' cleanliness or safety. Seven owned roots are available; no vessel, water, tool, heat source or suitable fuel is established. A dry, whole-root preparation is a feasible limited function for the current-conversation development handoff. No waiting for implementation advances the world. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience, pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for this review, study, a request, naming a lot or starting work. Preparation itself supplies no automatic mood or nutrition bonus. Actual meals use the existing consumption rules and actual nutrition; mood must not reduce basic nutrition. Actual observation may provide evidence-backed information gain, including a genuinely informative preparation failure, but inspection requests and repeated unchanged results do not qualify. Do not add a new preparation reward channel or duplicate rewards already attributed to observation, eating or social participation. Any existing event-based pleasure or maintained-satisfaction mechanism must retain its personal-applicability tests, bounded amount and cap, decay, cooldown and functional deduplication; ordinary familiar meal participation need not be novel. If those mechanisms lack executable eligibility and bounds, this capability awards zero rather than inventing them. No physical-comfort award is specified; the global comfort cap remains 10. Protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions remain unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable start, paid unit-check, debris-removal, unit-completion, pause, resume, cancel and failure events only when their respective actions occur. Use reusable metadata keyed by job ID and input/output item IDs: operation, stage, completed/requested units, visible condition, treatment, raw/unheated status, safety-unknown status where applicable, event time and failure reason. Preserve the roots' existing appearance while allowing an evidence-based reduction of visible loose dirt; no cooked color, steam, fire, vessel or cleanliness/safety seal is generated. Partial progress shows only completed units and the pending count, never a completed batch. Unsupported or failed preparation displays its actual failure and unchanged or genuinely changed material, not a successful meal. Shared-meal visuals require real independently executed transfers, consumption or communication events, not nearby neighbors or the applicant's intention.
reviews.specification:
Implement the general operation 'Prepare unheated food', parameterized by mode (inspect, prepare, inspect-progress, cancel), owned input stack ID, and positive whole-unit quantity. It applies to food that can actually be handled and prepared without cutting, water or heat; it is not specific to moss or roots. The minimal prepare mechanism is manual removal of loose surface debris followed by separation of selected whole units into an inspectable food lot. It neither peels nor sterilizes, cooks, invents ingredients, or makes unsuitable food edible. Reuse open.probe@foundation-open@1 observation logic where applicable, and the existing owned-stack, reservation, decay and transfer code; record these dependencies and reused code in the implementation, rather than presenting them as new inventions. New work is the paid preparation process and conserved food-lot output. Do not invoke probe's destructive physical-trial mode as a substitute for this process.
Inputs and references: resolve exact owned item IDs, not nearby plant stock or resource-name matches. For moss, item-3-moss-30 is the available root stack, quantity 7 and recorded decay 50.27044688; revalidate current quantity, ownership, reach, condition and accessibility at execution. The earlier planting inspection is incomplete and older, not a current safety certificate. Knowledge record root reports nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 observed at tick 48; retain its evidence scope rather than declaring every root safe. item-23-moss-260, quantity 0.9 branch, is not an ingredient or assumed fuel and remains untouched. Other applicants may use their own applicable food stacks. No hidden resources or facts are disclosed.
Prerequisites: independently completed study, usable hands, sufficient energy, physical reach to the input, and an actually supportable unheated preparation method for that food. No ground contact is required: work on one held whole unit at a time. If holding or preparation would require an unavailable implement or support, fail that prerequisite explicitly. Ordinary soil is not a clean preparation surface. Surface observations report only detectable spoilage, dirt and physical changes; lack of visible defects is not proof against unobservable hazards. Obvious spoiled or unsuitable units are not marked ready. Unknown safety remains explicitly unknown.
Costs and progress: study takes 2 rounds independently for each learner. Inspection costs 1 active round and 0.2 energy and consumes no food. Preparation costs 1 active round and 0.5 energy per whole unit, including its visible condition check and manual brushing. A quantity of seven therefore requires seven completed work rounds and 3.5 energy, in addition to any separately requested inspection, study, travel or transfer. Validate before each charge. Each completed unit produces one distinct processed unit or a stack-compatible addition to the prepared lot; unusable units remain identified, unprepared inputs. Emit a truthful unsuitable-unit result for a paid check that cannot prepare its unit. Never debit an entire batch in advance. No water, branch, fuel or edible material is consumed by this minimal whole-unit method. Only actual removable loose debris may be displaced; do not create collectible material stock from cosmetic debris. If debris removal would remove edible matter or require unsupported treatment, stop that unit rather than silently reducing mass.
Conservation and products: selected food units move from input to an owned prepared-food lot with unchanged edible quantity, origin, age, existing treatment history and decay trajectory. Record the actual dry-brushing treatment, original stack reference and per-unit outcome. Preserve represented nutrition, toxicity and spoilage effects; preparation cannot refresh food, improve nutrition or override hazards. Prepared and remaining units together equal the original food units, less only consumption or other independently logged actions. The lot consists of real roots, not a new free meal token or duplicated inventory. It can be inspected, transferred and eaten through the existing food interfaces. Do not assert successful cleanliness if the physical operation did not remove the observed loose debris.
Lifecycle: reserve only the pending unit against conflicting use. Track job ID, actor, resolved input IDs, requested quantity, completed-unit IDs, charges, current stage and failure reason. Leaving reach, insufficient energy, loss of usable hands or an invalid input pauses remaining work without further charge. Resume rechecks prerequisites and current food condition without resetting decay or repeating completed charges. Cancellation releases any surviving unprocessed reservation exactly once; completed lots remain actual products. Death ends work, releases remaining reservations through the existing death/inventory rules and leaves completed products subject to those rules. Do not conjure a return to a dead actor's inventory. No refund of elapsed time, spent energy or completed physical work. An interrupted atomic unit step commits neither its charge nor its output; committed steps cannot be refunded or repeated as free output. Global development/review pauses preserve work without advancing time.
Ongoing effects and sharing: no passive preparation, automatic maintenance, heating or continuing fuel process exists. Food keeps ageing under its existing rules, including while paused; dry preparation grants no shelf-life extension. Subsequent rechecking or re-preparation requires another real paid action. Sharing is optional and separate. Reuse give (forest.give, foundation-forest@1; 1 round, 0.5 energy, whole owned units and actual adjacent recipient), and eat (forest.eat, foundation-forest@1; 1 round, 1 energy and actual consumed units), with their exact schemas and validation. Actual participants must independently communicate willingness, accept applicable transfers and choose whether to eat. Preparation cannot issue their actions, infer consent, feed neighbors or alter their inventory without an executed authorized transfer. Implement all established checks and transitions in code; do not require repeated model approval.

Missing thermal mechanisms are development dependencies, not grounds for permanent rejection. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Three individual study rounds confer access only after implementation, not mastery, food, heat or experiential reward. No benefit for requesting, assessment invocation, naming, registration, blocked prerequisites or merely reading a missing-equipment list. A genuinely new, personally observed and verified result, including informative failure, may qualify under the existing experience ledger; deduplicate by underlying finding and conditions across probe and preparation. This capability creates no independent reward payout, satisfaction meter, nutrition bonus or guaranteed comfort. Any later legitimate practice benefit must use existing event-based caps, decay and cooldown rules; if no applicable coded rule exists, award none. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, and basic nutrition is not mood-scaled. Protected reward accounts, budget, goals and permissions remain unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable structured events only for actual assessment, setup, exposure, measured change, pause, resume, cancellation, completion or failure. Include work ID, actor, exact input/output/source references, position, simulation time, quantities, actual treatment, evidence references, safety status and failure reason. Reusable visual metadata should distinguish raw/unchanged, heating, heated-but-safety-unknown, scorched, paused and dependency-blocked states. Show flame, steam, glow or changed food appearance only when corresponding physical events occurred. A feasibility result may display an observation record and missing-prerequisite indicator, never a cooked-food icon or success animation. Thermal completion means only the specified observed thermal treatment completed; neither its label nor appearance certifies edibility.
reviews.specification:
General operation: assess or thermally prepare an owned food quantity, inspect work, or cancel. Parameters: exact inputStackId, quantity, mode, and, when heating, exact sourceId, support/tool/vessel IDs and recipe/evidence reference if one actually exists. Do not bind the operation to Kai or roots. Reuse probe observation semantics and existing inventory, ageing, ownership, work and event code; reuse unheated-food-preparation handling code only where applicable, without treating brushing as cooking. Before registering a new public capability, reconcile against full registry schemas in the existing development handoff.
Current references: item-60-kai-699 contains 2 owned roots at (15.2,19.3), origin commons-root-1-0; food safety unknown. item-24-kai-281 contains 0.8 branch at (11.4,18.25), not automatically carried, reachable or usable fuel. item-66-kai-763 contains 2 known-safe berries and is not an implicit cooking input. Source commons-root-1-0 is not owned cooking stock. Resolve live positions, quantity and ownership at execution rather than copying this snapshot.
Minimal executable precursor: assess costs one active simulation round and 0.2 energy, consumes no food or fuel, and requires the selected item to be within actual observation/handling reach. Report directly observable condition, existing treatment records and which explicitly supplied prerequisites are unverified or absent from the inspected arrangement. Do not search hidden inventory or world resources. The initial result may state that no usable heat source or cooking arrangement has been demonstrated; it must not claim none exists anywhere. A failed precondition check costs no material or energy and performs no work. Assessment never labels the roots edible or cooked.
Thermal mode requires an actual reachable heat source, a physically workable means of exposing and retrieving the selected food without unsupported safe bare-hand contact, and any method-specific tools, food-contact surface, vessel or water. A waterless method need not require a vessel or water if an actual supported arrangement exists. Ignition is a prerequisite only where the actual heat source requires it; a branch alone supplies neither ignition nor guaranteed fuel suitability. No tasting trial is used to establish safety. Movement, gathering, acquisition, ignition and communication remain separate actual actions, not free substeps.
Implement missing heat-transfer/source support in this same development handoff if no reusable mechanism exists. Until that support is executable, assessment remains available and heating reports the specific dependency unavailable, without charging a heating round. Do not invent a facility, fire, recipe or sequence of future unlocks. The heating dependency must define simulation-round duration, resource mass/thermal properties, source output, fuel consumption, transfer losses and exposure geometry before enabling thermal mode. These must be explicit versioned code constants or measured represented inputs, not model guesses on each call. No successful cooking claim from an arbitrary fixed timer.
Heating costs one active round and 0.5 actor energy per supervised work round, plus measured source energy and actual fuel consumed under that source's published code. Setup and safe removal each require one active round and 0.5 energy when physically applicable. Reserve, do not duplicate, the selected quantity. Log elapsed exposure and delivered heat each round, conserving source energy into food, apparatus and environmental losses. Fuel becomes represented combustion products and residues according to the source model; water loss becomes vapor, food loss becomes residue or waste. Preserve original food identity, origin, age, decay, untreated hazards and quantity accounting through splits. Report measured heating, softening, drying, scorching or spoilage only when modeled and actually reached. Never reset decay, grant nutrition, remove toxins or infer edibility merely from heating. A validated processing rule may change a particular hazard only when its exact evidence reference, food applicability and required conditions are met; otherwise safety remains unknown. Eating uses eat separately with actual nutrition and toxicity.
Persist work ID, input and apparatus references, reserved quantities, mode, accumulated active rounds, exposure, temperature where represented, consumption, observations and status. Recheck ownership, reach, energy and physical prerequisites before each charge. An unworked round or lost prerequisite pauses actor work without an extra work charge; passive heat transfer, ageing, combustion and hazards continue only through their real ongoing process rules. Pause is not automatic safe removal or extinguishing. Resume rechecks current arrangement and continues from actual state, not from a pristine input. Cancel costs one round and no actor energy, stops further intentional handling, releases reservations once and leaves food, hot apparatus and source in their actual locations and states. Death ends personal work and releases reservations without teleporting items or extinguishing a fire. Completed changes and consumed fuel/time/energy are never refunded; unused material is retained, not recreated. No maintenance is free: additional fuel, source tending and safe repositioning require actual inputs and actions. After implementation, established validation, progress, effects and lifecycle rules execute in code without repeated model review. Review/development waiting advances no simulation time.
